description: Risco Climático para cana-de-açúcar no Brasil_ 2009 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Na elaboração do Zoneamento Agroecológico para a cana-de-açúcar foram utilizadas avaliações da aptidão climática e o mais recentemente estudos probabilísticos da época (2009), baseados em séries climáticas históricas sobre os riscos climáticos por municípios brasileiros, definindo em função do ciclo e da demanda hídrica da cultura, ocorrência de geadas e veranicos, as melhores áreas e ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Brazil, geoscientificInformation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
